research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Systems and methods for predicting post transcriptional gene regulation using a neural network describe tissue specific modeling of post transcriptional gene regulation to predict mRNA stability, including micro RNA binding and degradation. Systems and methods for determining effects of therapies and genetic variation detail identifying tissue specific polyadenylation features and candidate polyadenylation sites in genomic sequences. Together these works indicate research and development in AI driven modeling of RNA regulation and therapy impact.

about_short_description.short_description: Deep Genomics is using artificial intelligence to build a new universe of life-saving genetic therapies.

product.name: AI Platform
product.description: An AI-driven platform that analyzes RNA biology data to identify novel genetic targets and therapeutic candidates for genetic diseases.

product.name: BigRNA
product.description: A foundation AI model for RNA biology that supports the identification of genetic mechanisms and therapeutic targets related to RNA splicing defects.

product.name: BigRNA+
product.description: An enhanced version of BigRNA designed to expand the range of genetic mechanisms and variants that can be analyzed for therapeutic discovery.

product.name: REPRESS
product.description: A deep learning model that predicts microRNA binding and mRNA degradation from RNA sequences to aid therapeutic design.

product.name: Steric-Blocking Oligonucleotides (SBOs) Development
product.description: Development of steric-blocking oligonucleotides to increase protein expression for treating genetic diseases.
